messages:
alyssa: heads up — discovered a regression where Console CSV export includes unmasked actor_email and ip_address for rows that are masked in the UI. repro steps: 1) Console > Audit > filter customer_id=cid-123 2) Click Export CSV 3) Inspect columns actor_email, ip_address — they are plaintext. sample CSV snippet:
```
actor_email,ip_address,event
"jdoe@acme.com","10.1.2.3","login.succeeded"
```
Possible root cause: exporter calls audit-decrypt service with a service principal that ignores row-level masking context. Not sure if this is tied to the patch that changed exporter auth (PR #2304).

sam: how severe? any customers confirmed? :rotating_light:

marta: confirmed on staging — I ran the same filter and CSV shows plaintext. Looks like the backend export path performs direct KMS/decrypt without passing user RBAC headers. Quick mitigation: disallow CSV export for tenants with row-level masking until we patch. I can flip a flag.

jen: escalate to triage. Treat as potential PII exposure. Mark severity P2 (possible data leakage). alyssa, attach logs and affected export job ids. We'll need to run vuln triage and coordinate disclosure if any customer downloaded sensitive CSVs.

alyssa: repro logs and request ids attached here: export_req=exp-7890, job_id=export-20265. Relevant log excerpt shows: 
```
INFO  export-service req=exp-7890 job=export-20265 user_id=svc-audit-export
DEBUG decrypt call: POST /internal/audit/decrypt body={"ciphertext": "..."} headers={}
DEBUG decrypt response: 200 {"plaintext":"jdoe@acme.com"}
```
Note: headers show no user or tenant scoping.

noah: temporary mitigation — I'll disable CSV exports globally until patch is in. Proposed command: 
```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/flags \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \\
  -d '{"flag":"console.audit.csv_enabled","value":false}'
```
I'll own the rollout and monitoring.

alyssa: created GH issue: redwood/redwood-infra#4521 (security/regression/export). Added repro, logs, and sample CSV. Also added the export_req id for searching S3.

marta: I can put a PR up today to ensure exporter proxies requests through the masking service and requires user ctx header before calling decrypt. Staging tests in ~3h, can ship to prod after review in ~6-8h. Will request review from @jen and @eng-platform codeowners.

jen: assign to current sec-eng rotation for vuln triage. Action items: 1) check S3 access logs for objects named export-* or matching exp-7890, 2) timeline of who downloaded artifacts, 3) prepare customer notification templates if exports left tenant boundary.

audit-bot: Incident created INC-2026-045 | severity=P2 | assignees=[marta,noah,alyssa] | link=https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-045

sam: thanks. PM will track affected customers and prepare comms if required. Keep me posted on the flag flip and PR status. :thumbsup:

alyssa: quick note — we should also audit the JSON export path and the streaming export API; CSV might not be the only path. Adding that to the GH issue.

marta: agreed. I'll add integration tests for masked fields across CSV/JSON/streaming and a gating policy in the exporter: refuse export if mask_check fails.

noah: flag flipped, monitoring in place. rolling back the toggle if any downstream issues. logs show export endpoints returning 403 for CSV now.

jen: thanks everyone. we'll update the incident board after PR merge and postmortem with remediation and timeline.
